rule: Evaluate every saved checkpoint closed-loop (through the frozen interface, with the chicken-head reflex if the demos used it) on the same 30 development episodes: instances-dev configs 0000-0009, episode k=0, each of the 3 tasks. Choose the checkpoint with the most successes; ties broken by the lower median sim time of successes, then by the earlier step. Imitation loss is reported but never used for selection (lessons file, item 6).
